objective: Phase 4 follow-up: reports/news_pead_feasibility.json's own limitations flagged 'Headline regex precision must be manually sampled before a return study' as a blocker before proceeding to a real news-conditioned return study. This resolves that blocker with a real, hand-checked sample against the live cached dataset.
data_source: state/news/alpaca_news_2026-01-01_2026-07-31.parquet (147,305 real Alpaca/Benzinga news articles, already cached from the original feasibility audit).
method: Drew a reproducible 120-headline random sample (pandas random_state=20260812) from every article backtest.news_pead_feasibility.is_earnings_result_headline() labeled a positive single-symbol earnings-result event, before any regex change. Hand-checked each headline: is it reporting an already-released earnings-related event (actual reported figures, or guidance issued/affirmed/revised as part of an earnings release, or commentary published in clear reaction to an already-released result) versus a forward-looking preview/forecast article or unrelated valuation commentary that merely contains a result-shaped word. Ground truth recorded in backtest/news_pead_feasibility_precision_labels.py (22 false-positive indices out of 120).

baseline_finding.false_positive_pattern: A recognizable templated family of Benzinga-style pre-earnings preview/forecast articles the original FORWARD_PATTERNS regex missed: 'Earnings Outlook For X' / "X's Earnings Outlook" (6 of 22), 'Insights Into X's [Q4] Earnings' (4 of 22), 'A Glimpse/Peek/Look Ahead ... Earnings [Potential/Forecast/Future]' (4 of 22), '... Ahead Of [Q4] Earnings' (3 of 22), 'Price Over Earnings Overview' (a P/E-ratio commentary template with no earnings-release content at all, 3 of 22), 'Exploring X's Earnings Expectations' (1 of 22), 'An Overview of X's Earnings' (1 of 22).

fix: Added six new FORWARD_PATTERNS entries to backtest/news_pead_feasibility.py: 'ahead of', 'outlook', 'expectations?', 'price over earnings', and a combined pattern for 'insights?' / 'a look ahead|glimpse|peek' / 'an overview of'.

post_fix_finding.recall_cost: 2 of the original 98 true positives were also filtered out by the new 'outlook' pattern (ADP's '... Up From Prior Outlook of 6%' and Qorvo's 'Q3 Earnings As Outlook Disappoints' -- both genuine post-release headlines that happen to mention outlook/guidance language). This is a disclosed precision-over-recall trade-off: the module's own docstring states its goal is a HIGH-PRECISION label, not a high-recall one, so losing a small number of genuine events to eliminate a much larger, structurally recognizable false-positive family is the correct trade for this study's purpose.

full_dataset_effect.note: Removed roughly 2,500 single-symbol events (~22%, consistent with the sampled false-positive rate). Still comfortably clears the pre-registered gate (>=500 single-symbol events, >=95% timestamp coverage) -- the feasibility decision itself (proceed_news_conditioned_event_study) is unchanged, now backed by measurably higher-precision data.

not_measured: This was re-verified only on the SAME sample the regex was tuned against (in-sample), not a fresh, independently-drawn out-of-sample batch. A held-out precision check on a newly-drawn sample (e.g. after 2026-08-13 news accrues, matching the repo's frozen-window discipline) would be a stronger confirmation before ever running the pre-registered return study on this event set -- flagged, not done here, given the improvement's mechanism (removing a structurally distinct, easily-recognizable template family) is unlikely to be an artifact of this specific sample, but this has not been independently confirmed.
